svg.title: Safety & limitations
svg.desc: Authorized networks only: Use only on networks you own or administer with permission. VPN REMOTE does not create a tunnel. x-ndw4 is unsupported.; Interpret results carefully: NAT snapshots may miss LAN/VPN flows; missing records are not grounds to block access. Open TCP ports do not prove service identity or business need. UDP is observed, not validated.; Keep evidence private: Credentials are not persisted. Keep internal addresses, raw dumps and customer reports private.; Windows security & updates: No trusted Authenticode signature yet. Do not disable protection. SHA-256 proves integrity, not publisher identity. Save reports before Tools → Updates; installer language is retained. Actions artifacts are not releases.; License & attribution: Interface independently developed with visual inspiration from Atoll. Retain applicable MIT notices if Atoll code is incorporated. Observer license not yet selected; public source does not grant redistribution rights.; Developer requirements: Windows 10/11 x64; .NET 10 SDK or Visual Studio with .NET desktop development.

g.text: OBSERVER / SIGNAL / 08
Safety & limitations
Authorized networks only
Use only on networks you own or administer with permission. VPN
REMOTE does not create a tunnel. x-ndw4 is unsupported.
Interpret results carefully
NAT snapshots may miss LAN/VPN flows; missing records are not
grounds to block access. Open TCP ports do not prove service identity
or business need. UDP is observed, not validated.
Keep evidence private
Credentials are not persisted. Keep internal addresses, raw dumps and
customer reports private.
Windows security & updates
No trusted Authenticode signature yet. Do not disable protection.
SHA-256 proves integrity, not publisher identity. Save reports before
Tools → Updates; installer language is retained. Actions artifacts are
not releases.
License & attribution
Interface independently developed with visual inspiration from Atoll.
Retain applicable MIT notices if Atoll code is incorporated. Observer
license not yet selected; public source does not grant redistribution
rights.
Developer requirements
Windows 10/11 x64; .NET 10 SDK or Visual Studio with .NET desktop
development.
KINGPROJECTS / NETWORK TOOLS
